brainlife.name: neuro/dtiinit

original.desc: Folder structure containing all files generated by the VISTASOFT dtiInit.m

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Input to vistasoft-based Apps: LiFE, AFQ, ConTrack and MRtrix 0.2 tracking. Extracting the aligned DWI, brain mask or tensor NIfTI maps.

**Not for:** Non-vistasoft Apps expecting a plain DWI; use the aligned dwi output instead.

**BIDS:** dwi/dwi (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 14 Apps, output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.dtiinit.json

files.desc: dtiInit directory (dt6.json, aligned DWI, bvecs, bvals, dti/ tensor and mask).

identifying_risks: Contains participant DWI volumes; headers may keep names, dates or device serials
Rare lesions can be recognisable in small samples
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level diffusion MRI without direct identifiers; DWI does not normally show a recognisable face.
sharing_cautions: Scrub headers and metadata before sharing
Share under a data use agreement
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if it carries identifying headers or a non-defaced head image
